//----- Regenerated by session tooling from the final patched project.json -----------------------------------------

WhenGreenFlagClicked()
{
  power = '100%';
  time = '12 AM';
  wait = '0';
  currentman = '';
  currentwomen = '';
  currentwomen2 = '';
  previous cam man = '';
  previous cam woman = '';
  previous cam woman2 = '';
  Control.Wait('5');
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(forever)
{
  Wait Until ((wait == '0'));
  If ((camera == 'CAM1'))
  {
    If (((camera == 'CAM1') And Contains(camlist['1'], 'man')))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(man);
      Stop(this script);
    }
    If (((camera == 'CAM1') And Contains(camlist['1'], 'women1')))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(women1);
      Stop(this script);
    }
    If (((camera == 'CAM1') And Contains(camlist['1'], 'women2')))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(women2);
      Stop(this script);
    }
  }
  Else
  {
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(1);
  }
  If ((camera == 'CAM2'))
  {
    If (((camera == 'CAM2') And Contains(camlist['2'], 'man')))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(man);
      Stop(this script);
    }
    If (((camera == 'CAM2') And Contains(camlist['2'], 'women1')))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(women1);
      Stop(this script);
    }
    If (((camera == 'CAM2') And Contains(camlist['2'], 'women2')))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(women2);
      Stop(this script);
    }
  }
  Else
  {
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(1);
  }
  If ((camera == 'CAM3'))
  {
    If (((camera == 'CAM3') And Contains(camlist['3'], 'man')))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(man);
      Stop(this script);
    }
    If (((camera == 'CAM3') And Contains(camlist['3'], 'women1')))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(women1);
      Stop(this script);
    }
    If (((camera == 'CAM3') And Contains(camlist['3'], 'women2')))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(women2);
      Stop(this script);
    }
  }
  Else
  {
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(1);
  }
  If ((camera == 'CAM4'))
  {
    If (((camera == 'CAM4') And Contains(camlist['4'], 'man')))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(man);
      Stop(this script);
    }
    If (((camera == 'CAM4') And Contains(camlist['4'], 'women1')))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(women1);
      Stop(this script);
    }
    If (((camera == 'CAM4') And Contains(camlist['4'], 'women2')))

      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(women2);
      Stop(this script);
    }
  }
  Else
  {
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(1);
  }
  If ((camera == 'CAM5'))
  {
    If (((camera == 'CAM5') And Contains(camlist['5'], 'man')))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(man);
      Stop(this script);

    If (((camera == 'CAM5') And Contains(camlist['5'], 'women1')))

      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(women1);

    If (((camera == 'CAM5') And Contains(camlist['5'], 'women2')))
    {
      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(women2);
      Stop(this script);
    }
  }
  Else
  {
    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(1);
  }
  If ((camera == 'CAM6'))
  {
    If (((camera == 'CAM6') And Contains(camlist['6'], 'man')))
    {

      Stop(this script);

    }
    If (((camera == 'CAM6') And Contains(camlist['6'], 'women2')))

      Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(women2);

  Else

    Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(1);

  If ((camera == 'CAM7'))

WhenKeyPressed(w)
{
  List.Show(camlist);
}

WhenKeyPressed(s)
{
  List.Hide(camlist);
}

Define rng man %s
{
  Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(man);
  goto man = goto;
  previous cam man = goto man;
  List.Add(manlist, Join('CAM', (Letter('4', goto man) + '-1')));
  List.Add(manlist, Join('CAM', (Letter('4', goto man) + '-2')));
  goto man = manlist[Random(List.IndexOf(manlist, manlist['2']), List.IndexOf(manlist, manlist['1']))];
  List.ReplaceItem(camlist, Letter('4', goto man), Join(Costume.GetNumberName(name), Join('(', Join(goto man, ')'))));
  List.ReplaceItem(camlist, Letter('4', previous cam man), goto);
  wait = '0';
  Control.Wait('1');
  List.DeleteAll(manlist);
  Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(1);
}

Define rng women %s
{
  Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(women1);
  goto women = goto;
  previous cam woman = goto women;
  List.Add(womanlist, Join('CAM', (Letter('4', goto women) + '-1')));
  List.Add(womanlist, Join('CAM', (Letter('4', goto women) + '-2')));
  goto women = womanlist[Random(List.IndexOf(womanlist, womanlist['2']), List.IndexOf(womanlist, womanlist['1']))];
  currentwomen = goto women;
  List.ReplaceItem(camlist, Letter('4', goto women), Join(Costume.GetNumberName(name), Join('(', Join(goto women, ')'))));
  wait = '0';
  Control.Wait('1');
  List.DeleteAll(womanlist);
  Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(1);
}

Define rngwomen2 %s
{
  Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(women2);
  goto women2 = goto;
  previous cam woman2 = goto women2;
  List.Add(woman2list, Join('CAM', (Letter('4', goto women2) + '-1')));
  List.Add(woman2list, Join('CAM', (Letter('4', goto women2) + '-2')));
  goto women2 = woman2list[Random(List.IndexOf(woman2list, woman2list['2']), List.IndexOf(woman2list, woman2list['1']))];
  List.ReplaceItem(camlist, Letter('4', goto women2), Join(Costume.GetNumberName(name), Join('(', Join(goto women2, ')'))));
  List.ReplaceItem(camlist, Letter('4', previous cam woman2), goto);
  wait = '0';
  Control.Wait('1');
  List.DeleteAll(woman2list);
  Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(1);
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(death)
{
  Control.Wait('2');
  Sound.Play(sound_sounds_menu({'SOUND_MENU': ['Big Boing', None]}));
  Motion.GoToXY('0', '0');
  Looks.SwitchCostumeTo(man);
  Looks.SetEffectTo(GHOST, '0');
  Looks.Show();
  Repeat ('10')
  {
    Motion.GoTo(motion_goto_menu({'TO': ['_random_', None]}));
  }
}

WhenGreenFlagClicked()
{
  Forever
  {
    Motion.GoTo(motion_goto_menu({'TO': ['Cams', None]}));
  }
}

WhenBroadcastReceived(reset pos)
{
}

WhenGreenFlagClicked()
{
  Call rng man('CAM4');
  Call rng women('CAM3');
  Call rngwomen2('CAM5');
  Repeat Until ((power == '0%'))
  {
    Control.Wait('4');
    Call rng man(Join('CAM', (Letter('4', previous cam man) + Random('-2', '2'))));
    Call rng women(Join('CAM', (Letter('4', previous cam woman) + Random('-2', '2'))));
    Call rngwomen2(Join('CAM', (Letter('4', previous cam woman2) + Random('-2', '2'))));
  }
  Call rng man(Join('CAM', (Letter('4', previous cam man) + Random('-1', '2'))));
  Call rng women(Join('CAM', (Letter('4', previous cam woman) + Random('-1', '2'))));
  Call rngwomen2(Join('CAM', (Letter('4', previous cam woman2) + Random('-1', '2'))));
  Control.Wait('1');
  reset = '0';
}
